What @Haroenv means is that [the template uses a script tag](https://github.com/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/blob/a2c0687d16fbb659307e99facccd12fad19f0301/instantsearch.js/index.html#L48) which CodeSandbox might not be able to replace during deployment.

> What @Haroenv means is that [the template uses a script tag](https://github.com/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/blob/a2c0687d16fbb659307e99facccd12fad19f0301/instantsearch.js/index.html#L48) which CodeSandbox might not be able to replace during deployment.

You're right. What do you think of adding instantsearch.js as a dependency in create-react-app template and `import` it there? Any blocker? If not, I'll send a PR.

I'm not sure if it's good to use the ES module in vanilla example, though. What do you think?
I think it's better to use a different example which imports
Yeah I think it's a bit too early to move to imports in the sandbox because we document the UMD usage everywhere in the documentation. We can create an InstantSearch.js ESM template.

Okay sounds good. I guess I can just create a code sandbox which imports es module and use it as the base for the PRs.
Or, do you want to have it in a proper repo like doc-code-samples?
